what_happened.line: The Planning Board adopted the Economic Development Committee charge as drafted, passing unanimously.
The board took up a vote to support the Saliba land acquisition at Town Meeting if asked; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The board approved the ANR plan for 71 Wildwood Road; the vote on the Youngs Road ANR plan was not audible.
Members will send master plan element rankings before the next meeting, and a matrix will be discussed on 25 November.
Solar bylaw changes were discussed, covering screening, size, pollinator habitat and tree clearing, with no vote taken.

why_it_matters: The Saliba land purchase and master plan funding both involve town money that voters may be asked to approve at Town Meeting, and the board's position is one input to that vote.
Solar bylaw changes under discussion could affect where and how large solar arrays may be built in town, including screening and tree clearing.
watch_next: 25 November: the board is to discuss the compiled master plan element rankings matrix.
Forms for two at-large Economic Development Committee seats, to be put out by the town.
